text:
Start date: 1817-01-19  
Add 30 weeks = 210 days.  
Add 6 days = total 216 days.  
1817 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but by 100 and not by 400).  
Jan 19 + 216 days:  
Jan has 31 days → days left in Jan = 12 → 216 - 12 = 204 left.  
Feb has 28 days → 204 - 28 = 176 left.  
Mar has 31 → 176 - 31 = 145 left.  
Apr has 30 → 145 - 30 = 115 left.  
May has 31 → 115 - 31 = 84 left.  
Jun has 30 → 84 - 30 = 54 left.  
Jul has 31 → 54 - 31 = 23 left.  
Aug 1 + 23 days = Aug 24, 1817.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1817-08-24
